sections.text_helper: Section 31.3.16 "Combined 3-phase PWM mode" in chapter 31 (Advanced-control timers (TIM1/TIM8)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1003.
sections.section_content:
Combined 3-phase PWM mode allows one to three center-aligned PWM signals to be
generated with a single programmable signal ANDed in the middle of the pulses. The
tim_oc5ref signal is used to define the resulting combined signal.
The 4 bits GC5C[4:1] in the TIM_CCR5 allow selection on which reference signal the
tim_oc5ref is combined. The resulting signals, tim_ocxrefc, are made of an AND logical
combination of two reference PWMs:
• If GC5C1 is set, tim_oc1refc is the logical AND of tim_oc1ref and tim_oc5ref
• If GC5C2 is set, tim_oc2refc is the logical AND of tim_oc2ref and tim_oc5ref
• If GC5C3 is set, tim_oc3refc is the logical AND of tim_oc3ref and tim_oc5ref
• If GC5C4 is set, tim_oc4refc is the logical AND of tim_oc4ref and tim_oc5ref
It is possible also to select an OR fonction with GC5C1O, GC5C2O, GC5C3O and GC5C4O
bits, as following:
• If GC5C1O is set, tim_oc1refc is the logical OR of tim_oc1ref and tim_oc5ref
• If GC5C2O is set, tim_oc2refc is the logical OR of tim_oc2ref and tim_oc5ref
• If GC5C3O is set, tim_oc3refc is the logical OR of tim_oc3ref and tim_oc5ref
• If GC5C4O is set, tim_oc4refc is the logical OR of tim_oc4ref and tim_oc5ref
If both GC5Cx and GC5CxO bits are set, GC5Cx bit overrides GC5CxO programming and
tim_ocxrefc is equal to tim_ocxref AND tim_oc5ref.
Combined 3-phase PWM mode can be selected independently on channels 1 to 4 by setting
at least one of the bits GC5C[4:1] or GC5CO[4:1].
